sections.title: Openers
sections.content:
In today's office, AI is everywhere. In an increasingly connected workplace, the inventory matters. In this lesson you will learn how an inventory grows. Whether you are a manager or a clerk, the list is the same.

Let's dive in. Let's explore the inbox first.

sections.title: Filler
sections.content: We delve into every tool. A robust filter helps, and a robust list helps more. A comprehensive, holistic, seamless, cutting-edge, best-in-class inventory is a game-changer. The tool landscape shifts, and the vendor landscape shifts faster.

sections.title: Hedges
sections.content: It is important to note that inventories change. It's worth noting that versions change. It should be noted that vendors rename products.

sections.title: Transitions
sections.content: Furthermore, spreadsheets count. Moreover, chat tools count. As mentioned above, the spam filter counts, and as you already know, translation counts. To sum up, everything counts.

sections.title: Claims and counters
sections.content:
Experts agree that a disruptive tool changes the office. Teams leverage the inventory to empower staff and unlock the potential of synergy. Imagine a mailbox that sorts itself.

The inventory is not only a list but also a tool, and not only a tool but also a ritual. It serves both managers and clerks, both offices and workshops, both today and tomorrow. A certificate is not a certificate of participation.

sections.title: Structure
sections.content:
First the filter counts. Second the mail counts. Third the chat counts. Fourth the sheet counts. Fifth the translation counts. Sixth the camera counts.

- Filter
- Mail
- Chat

- Sheet
- Translation
- Camera

- Map
- Photo
- Dictation

In conclusion, everything counts and the inventory grows.

quiz.explanation: The inventory records every function, not just product names.

sections.title: Maintenance
sections.content: Imagine the list is done. Then maintenance begins.
